subject: Outdated R Base on Ubuntu Repository

messages.author: d48c25039d976859
messages.subject: Outdated R Base on Ubuntu Repository
parts:
I am running Shiny server on Ubunutu. I am wanting to run some dashboards I have built using Shiny dashboards but I cannot install all of the dependencies because the R-base on the Ubuntu repository is an older R base required by the dependencies. I think 3.0. The error is telling me I need 3.1 or greater. I have tried to install a .deb build of the latest R build but I can’t because Ubuntu is telling me I should use the one in the repository. Can somebody tell me how I can upgrade my R-base in Ubuntu to the latest R base?

Thanks.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Outdated R Base on Ubuntu Repository
parts:
You really should use the CRAN repository instead of the official
Ubuntu repo. The version of R in the latter is often years behind the
latest version of R. You can easily add the CRAN repo on
Ubuntu/Debian:

sudo apt-add-repository -y "deb http://cran.rstudio.com/bin/linux/ubuntu `lsb_release -cs`/"
sudo apt-key adv --keyserver keyserver.ubuntu.com --recv-keys E084DAB9
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get upgrade

More info: http://cran.rstudio.com/bin/linux/ubuntu/

Regards,
Yihui
